description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Six shared-schema layers describe active and historical development-engineering projects: other land uses, short plats, mobile homes, large lots, formal plats and commercial development. They expose project identifiers, type/status, lots submitted/approved, permits and parcels. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. Grouped as project-type components of the same development inventory. Proposed or approved lots are not proof of completed buildings; the formal-plats source description says format plat. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
